# Report a violation.
Tell management about a rule issue in your building or community. We log every report and review it against your association's declaration and rules.

**Emergency?** Do not use this form. For flooding, fire, a gas smell, or an elevator entrapment, call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652). If anyone is in danger, call 911 first.

## Report a rule issue.
Be specific: what happened, where, and when. If you have photos, attach them to the email that opens.

- **[773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652)** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

- **[service@centerpointmgmt.com](mailto:service@centerpointmgmt.com)** Replies within one business day

- **5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S** Chicago, IL 60625

## What happens after you report.
Your report is logged with the date, the location, and the rule involved. Management reviews it against the declaration, bylaws, and rules your board has adopted, and may ask you for more detail or photos. If the issue is a repair problem rather than a conduct problem, we route it to maintenance instead, because a work order usually resolves it faster than a notice.

Enforcement decisions belong to your board, following the procedure in your governing documents. Under Illinois law an owner must receive notice and an opportunity to be heard before the board imposes a fine. Because of that process, we cannot always share the outcome of a specific report with the person who filed it.

Read more about [how we manage violations](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/violation-management) and the [most common condo rule violations in Chicago](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/blog/common-condo-rule-violations-chicago).

## Common questions.

### Will the owner I report know it was me?
Management uses your contact details to follow up with you. If you are concerned about how your report will be handled, say so in the report or call our office before you send it.

### What if the problem is happening right now?
For ongoing noise or disturbances, call our office at [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652) during business hours. For anything dangerous or illegal, call 911.

### Can I report a problem with a common area that needs repair?
Yes, but use the [maintenance request form](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/resources/maintenance-request). Repairs are handled faster as work orders than as violation reports.
